verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a mobile terminal and coding client. It connects to VS Code for web, GitHub Codespaces and GitPod, and it offers resilient SSH/Mosh sessions for travel, so a developer could indirectly reach a remote environment and inspect code changes. Nothing in the evidence documents a pull-request review workflow; this is an indirect path through other tools, not a delivered feature. Missing for 10: any documented PR review capability (diff viewing, commenting, approving), explicit git/GitHub integration in Blink itself, phone-specific (vs iPad) review experience evidence, independent hands-on corroboration.
